ctx.x: Always talking about the proper dress.

Right. Well, see, all of those guys were very, very -- and another good friend of mine from New Orleans, who had a band here years ago, I never had the pleasure of working with him, Mr. Elgar. I always called -- Charles Elgar. And his band -- man, I mean, he wore tails, and big, tall, six-two or something like that, thin, and he looked like a prince. Real, real -- and he worked at Paddy Harmon's Dreamland for years. He worked at the old -- this brings back memories to me -- the old Navy Pier Ballroom there. This…
At the end of the pier?
